memory_notes: The 28 baseline timing runs recorded resident memory after model teardown. Do not use that field as serving memory. Their peak RSS remains a process high-water mark. The eight focused probes keep every model instance loaded through the snapshot and are the serving-memory evidence. Their 32 timing samples are not tail-latency evidence.
scope_notes: Linux i7-14700K, four distinct P cores selected with taskset, warm filesystem caches, two alternating A/B rounds and 1,000 samples per configuration. Other work on this shared machine was not stopped; retained load observations bound interpretation. Package numbers are unstripped release binaries plus the CPU ORT shared library, excluding model assets and platform-provided libraries. HTTP and accelerator work follows in later issues.
http_notes: Four real server runs of 1,000 loopback requests each. HTTP evidence uses a development opt-level=1/debug=0 server; it must not be used to subtract transport overhead from the release CPU numbers. The direct Rust/HTTP parity test passes for both engines.
